# Once In A Blue Moon

> A personal development and productivity platform combining interactive tools, educational content, and practical life guidance.

Once In A Blue Moon offers a unique blend of web applications for task management and learning, alongside thoughtful articles on personal development, health, and science. The site emphasizes practical strategies for goal-setting, decision-making, and self-improvement through both digital tools and educational content.

## Key Topics

- Personal Development
- Self-Improvement
- Task Management
- Goal-Setting
- Life Strategy
- Productivity
- Learning Tools
- Decision-Making
- Work Ethic
- Leadership
- Health & Nutrition
- Gene Therapy
- Spaced Repetition
- WordPress Integration
- Feedback Loops

## Core Tools & Applications

- [To Do List](https://onceinabluemoon.ca/to-do-list): Task Manager web app for productivity and task organization
- [Online Flash Card App](https://onceinabluemoon.ca/online-flash-card-app): Flashcard app using spaced repetition for learning and memory
- [Arcturus Radio](https://onceinabluemoon.ca/arcturus-radio): Arcturus Radio streaming platform for education and entertainment
- [Text](https://onceinabluemoon.ca/text): WordPress content filtering and tag management tool

## Personal Development & Life Strategy

- [There Is a Happy Path](https://onceinabluemoon.ca/there-is-a-happy-path): Practical guide on life strategy, goal-setting, and decision-making
- [How to Be a Role Model by Leading by Example](https://onceinabluemoon.ca/how-to-be-a-role-model-by-leading-by-example): Leadership guide on integrity, influence, and leading by example
- [Nothing Is Going to Work Unless You Do](https://onceinabluemoon.ca/nothing-is-going-to-work-unless-you-do): Motivational article on work ethic, perseverance, and achievement

## Health & Nutrition

- [Is a 72 Hour Fast Healthy?](https://onceinabluemoon.ca/is-a-72-hour-fast-healthy): Health analysis of prolonged fasting risks and medical considerations
- [How Many Carbs in One Slice of Pizza?](https://onceinabluemoon.ca/how-many-carbs-in-one-slice-of-pizza): Nutrition guide comparing carbs across pizza chains and crusts
- [How fast does the body digest and recover from one gram of sugar, and what if the body already has enough carbs?](https://onceinabluemoon.ca/how-fast-does-the-body-digest-and-recover-from-one-gram-of-sugar-and-what-if-the-body-already-has-enough-carbs): Explanation of sugar digestion, glucose metabolism, and insulin response

## Science & Medical Research

- [Gene Therapy Skysona: Weighing Cancer Risks Against Lifesaving Benefits for Rare Neurological Disease](https://onceinabluemoon.ca/gene-therapy-skysona-weighing-cancer-risks-against-lifesaving-benefits-for-rare-neurological-disease): Analysis of Skysona gene therapy for cerebral adrenoleukodystrophy
